facts.fact: Banco Angolano de Investimentos and Bank of China's Luanda branch signed a memorandum on 8 September 2026 to open a renminbi clearing account, develop RMB settlement and clearing services and support BAI's indirect accession to China's CIPS cross-border interbank payment system, with no live date stated (Mercado).

systems.country_label: Angola (BAI, indirect access via Bank of China)
